name: pria-vault-medic
description: Pria Vault Medic — self-healing IP Vault triage loop for in-VM agents. Grades vault health, classifies broken/unhealthy files by issue type, offers non-destructive repair verbs (requeue|reload|reingest), and re-grades to verify improvement. Interfaces with Praxis's public REST API via API-key authentication.

config.description: Pria API base URL. Defaults to https://pria.praxislxp.com.
Pria API key (pria_<40 hex chars>). Prefer PRIA_API_KEY env var.
